summary_of_changes: Replaced invalid label['bboxes'] access with label['instances'].bboxes; implemented 2x context expansion; dynamic pixel-coordinate scaling; secondary lesion visibility thresholding (min 0.30); diagnostic counters; and popped _is_context_cropped to guarantee collate_fn key alignment.

Separated AP@50 (from box.ap50) and AP@50-95 (from box.maps) per class; updated summary JSON with canonical keys per_class_ap50 and per_class_map50_95; updated Markdown report generation with explicit tables.
Separated per_class_ap50 and per_class_map50_95 in evaluate_test_set; added dynamic img_width and img_height to parse_yolo_labels; updated benchmark report tables.

Enforced strict protocol selection based on primary validation mAP@50-95 (removed arbitrary 0.5% margin tie-break); tie-break evaluated only on numerical floating-point tie (<= 1e-5); added dynamic image dimensions to parse_yolo_labels; eliminated invalid escape sequence syntax warning.

Replaced unconstrained inner-loop prediction matching with true 1-to-1 bipartite greedy matching based on descending IoU (preventing prediction reuse across ground-truth objects); added dynamic image dimensions to parse_yolo_labels.
Refactored coordinate calculation to explicitly scale horizontal axis with img_width and vertical axis with img_height instead of hardcoded 640.0.
Audited script with python -W error -m py_compile; confirmed zero SyntaxWarnings and zero syntax errors present.
